facts.text: A multi-panel character reference sheet is arranged in three rows: a large cinematic hero image at top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and four detail views along the bottom.
The top panel, labeled 'HERO', shows the person standing on a wet, reflective rooftop or elevated walkway at night, with metal railings and blurred city lights behind them.
Rain streaks and wet surfaces are visible in the hero panel.
In the hero panel, the person wears an all-black outfit: a high-collared tactical jacket over a black shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The person has short, closely cropped sides and dark hair gathered into a small topknot at the back of the head.
The middle row is labeled 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', and 'BACK' beneath three standing full-body views against a dark studio background.
The bottom row contains labeled detail panels: 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', and 'BOOTS'.
The 'FACE' close-up shows a neutral, serious expression, with the head facing the camera and the hair pulled back.
The 'JACKET COLLAR' detail shows a black fabric collar with straps, a metal buckle, and stitched construction.
The 'HANDS' detail shows two hands with visible grime or weathering on the skin and relaxed, slightly curled fingers.
The 'BOOTS' detail shows black leather lace-up combat boots with scuffed toes and thick soles.
The overall palette is dark: black and charcoal clothing, cool blue-gray night tones, and small warm amber highlights from lights.
Visible text in the image consists of the section labels 'HERO', 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', 'BACK', 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', and 'BOOTS'.

limitations: The exact location of the hero panel and the person's identity are not established by the image.
